name: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant B-cell lymphoma (formerly NLPHL)
theme: the renamed entity · the transformation watch

meta.title: NLPBL in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant B-cell lymphoma (ICC 2022 name; WHO5 retains 'nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma'), adult and pediatric-adjacent
meta.population: Patients with the SPLIT-NAME DISEASE: the 2022 ICC renamed NLPHL to nodular lymphocyte-predominant B-cell lymphoma (NLPBL - recognizing the CD20+ LP cells' B-cell program), while WHO-HAEM5 RETAINED the Hodgkin name - two classifications, two names, one disease (~5% of Hodgkin diagnoses; GHSG 394/8,298 = 4.7%, verified). THE AUTHORING CORRECTION IS PART OF THE RECORD: this spec's own premise arrived inverted ('WHO5 renamed it') and the verification sweep caught and corrected it - the discipline demonstrated on the author, again. THE NOMENCLATURE TRAP is operational, not academic: registries index this disease under the OLD name, so searching under the new one misses the only open trials on Earth. Indolent, young-skewing, and the curriculum is RESTRAINT: patients die WITH this disease far more often than OF it (verified framing - late therapy effects outkill the lymphoma), and the transformation watch is the standing discipline.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the split-name disease where restraint is the curriculum. THE INDOLENT TRUTH, verified: excellent survival across every series - complete excision alone in pediatric stage IA gave 100% OS (51/58 CR; PFS 57% - the relapse tail without the survival cost, verified), EuroNet-PHL-LP1's resection-only arm ran 79.5% five-year EFS (read out 2026; its PubMed publication resisted matching - flagged), and adult stage IA radiotherapy alone gave ~90% 8-year PFS with ~100% OS (GHSG, verified). Deaths come more from therapy's late effects than from the lymphoma - so…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: ICC 2022 (NLPBL - the rename receipt verified, with its near-title citation-entry trap caught) vs WHO-HAEM5 (NLPHL retained - verified, with its Correction-entry trap caught); Fan immunoarchitectural patterns (verified: six patterns; the diffuse THRLBCL-like pattern independently predicts recurrence); Ann Arbor staging with STAGE IA COMPLETELY EXCISED as its own branch (the observation option)
meta.response: Standard lymphoma response criteria - with the RE-BIOPSY-EVERY-RELAPSE rule as the response discipline that matters most: late relapse is common and usually still indolent, but 6-14% transform to aggressive B-cell lymphoma (THRLBCL/DLBCL spectrum), and a relapse treated without re-biopsy is a transformation missed

Newly diagnosed.name: Observation after complete excision (stage IA - the biopsy was the treatment)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: a guideline option for completely excised stage IA (NCCN secondhand; receipts verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: prospective pediatric + trial receipts (verified/flagged as noted) - the strongest evidence restraint has anywhere in the registry
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none - which is the entire point in a disease whose deaths come from therapy's late effects
Newly diagnosed.patient: If the biopsy surgery removed everything: careful watching - the surgery may already have been the whole treatment, and the studies that tested this show essentially everyone does well.

Newly diagnosed.name: ISRT alone (early stage - the focused option)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the early-stage preferred option (NCCN secondhand; ILROG matched)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: large registry/series (verified) - no RCT, like everything else here until NORM
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: field-dependent late effects - small fields, deliberately, in young patients
Newly diagnosed.patient: For early-stage disease that wasn't fully removed: a short course of focused radiation - with survival in the long-term studies at essentially one hundred percent.

Newly diagnosed.name: Rituximab alone (the response that flatters and fades)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: a guideline option across stages (NCCN secondhand) - at its honest durability grade
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: among the gentlest ledgers in oncology - which is exactly why the durability honesty matters
Newly diagnosed.patient: The antibody alone: virtually everyone responds, gently - and the response typically holds for about three years rather than forever, which the card says plainly.

Newly diagnosed.name: R-CHOP (advanced/symptomatic - the B-cell logic, retrospective grade)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: an advanced-stage option (NCCN secondhand) - habit-grade evidence, said
Newly diagnosed.evidence: retrospective series both habits (verified receipts); no RCT ever (absence verified) - NORM is the first
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: anthracycline + alkylator ledgers in a population with decades ahead - the late-effects counseling is inside the decision
Newly diagnosed.patient: For advanced disease causing problems: the standard B-cell chemotherapy-plus-antibody - chosen by biological logic and experience, because a head-to-head trial between the candidate regimens has never existed; the first-ever randomized study in this disease is enrolling now.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Declining treatment remains a real choice - and in this gentle disease, even that choice usually means years.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Gentle strategies for indolent relapse (rituximab re-treatment and kin)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: indolent-relapse convention (NCCN secondhand) - re-biopsy first, always
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: series grade (matched receipts); the flagged median says teaching estimate
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: gentle by design - matched to a disease that relapses gently
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: When the disease returns still in its gentle form: gentle re-treatment - usually the antibody again - with decades still the expectation.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: R-chemotherapy salvage (symptomatic/bulky relapse, still NLPBL)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: symptomatic-relapse convention (NCCN secondhand) - habit grade, said
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: retrospective/habit grade (receipts as noted); the flagged median says teaching estimate
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: regimen-dependent; the late-effects arithmetic still applies
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: For a returning disease that is causing real problems (and confirmed still the gentle type): antibody-plus-chemotherapy - with the same honesty that these regimens were never raced against each other.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Comfort-focused care
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: Comfort-focused care remains a real choice at every step.

POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

THE GLOW SUPERSESSION (patterns demoted, verbatim): Binkley et al., 'International Prognostic Score for Nodular Lymphocyte-Predominant Hodgkin Lymphoma' (J Clin Oncol 2024;42:2271-2280 - PMID 38531001, pubmed-eutils abstract read 2026-08-27): Global nLPHL One Working Group, 2,243 patients, IAP scored in 916. VERBATIM: 'On MVA, IAPs were not associated with PFS or OS, but IAP E had higher risk of transformation (hazard ratio [HR], 1.81; P < .05).' The LP-IPS is built from age >=45, stage III-IV, hemoglobin <10.5, and splenic involvement - pattern is NOT a component. The 2003 Fan independent-predictor claim is superseded: pattern survives only as the THRLBCL-like transformation edge.

CARDIAC DYSFUNCTION PREVENTION/MONITORING: Armenian et al., ASCO Clinical Practice Guideline (J Clin Oncol 2017;35:893-911 - PMID 27918725, pubmed-eutils abstract read 2026-08-27): initiate the cardiac-dysfunction discussion BEFORE beginning therapy where risk is sufficiently high; higher-risk populations may benefit from prevention and screening strategies during cancer-directed therapy; keep clinical suspicion high and the evaluation threshold low after potentially cardiotoxic therapy. Companion European framework: 2022 ESC cardio-oncology guidelines (PMID 36017568, esummary-verified).

HBV SCREENING (the reactivation law): Hwang et al., 'Hepatitis B Virus Screening and Management for Patients With Cancer Prior to Therapy: ASCO Provisional Clinical Opinion Update' (J Clin Oncol 2020;38:3698-3715 - PMID 32716741, pubmed-eutils abstract read 2026-08-27): ALL patients anticipating systemic anticancer therapy tested with 3 tests (HBsAg, anti-HBc total Ig/IgG, anti-HBs) WITHOUT delaying therapy. Chronic HBV (HBsAg+): antiviral prophylaxis through and >=12 months after therapy. Past HBV (HBsAg-/anti-HBc+) + HIGH-RISK therapy (anti-CD20 antibodies, SCT): prophylaxis during and >=12 months after; monitoring only as an adherence-dependent alternative.
